set.body: Released cortical slice 0.2.0 at fb2384a77f6905313f67247abafe14e2759cfb66: exact surface domains, four qualified fsaverage164k/fsLR32k directed native routes, exact MNI6/MNI2009c population cortical projection, separately declared aligned ribbon sampling, public template/atlas APIs, pinned engine and source-bound numerical evidence. Remaining scope: CIFTI with preserved subcortex, directed surface-to-volume rasterization, other surface densities, CIVET, specialist templates and further anatomical validation. See plans/template-transform-coverage.md and plans/resume-neuroatlas.md. Numerical agreement does not establish anatomical accuracy, inverse, Workbench parity or conservation; retained historical failures and frozen gates remain authoritative.
set.title: Expand transform coverage beyond cortical 0.2.0
